title: How to Make a Paper Airplane

steps.title: Create the Center Crease
steps.instruction: Fold the paper in half lengthwise, then unfold it.

steps.title: Fold the Top Corners
steps.instruction: Fold both top corners inward to meet the center crease.

steps.title: Create the Wings
steps.instruction: Fold the paper in half along the center crease, then fold each side down to form wings.
steps.additional_guidance: Make both wings approximately equal in size.
